title: Hess's Law Enthalpy Cycle Diagram Builder
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive Hess's Law enthalpy cycle diagram builder for a chemistry lab environment.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use an orthographic camera looking down the Z-axis at a 2D-style diagram workspace (z=0 plane). Camera should frame a region roughly from (-12,-8) to (12,8) world units.
- Background color: #1a1a2e (dark navy). Add a subtle grid on the z=0 plane with 1-unit spacing, color #2a2a4e.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.6) and a directional light from (5,10,7) intensity 0.8.

ENTHALPY LEVELS (horizontal bars):
- The diagram models the combustion of carbon: C(s)+O2(g) -> CO2(g) via two paths.
- There are exactly 3 enthalpy levels represented as horizontal colored bars (BoxGeometry, width=8, height=0.3, depth=0.1):
  * Level A (top, y=5): 'C(s) + O₂(g)' — color #4ecdc4
  * Level B (middle, y=0): 'CO(g) + ½O₂(g)' — color #ff6b6b
  * Level C (bottom, y=-4): 'CO₂(g)' — color #ffe66d
- Each bar has a TextGeometry or sprite label to its right showing the species name.
- Each bar is draggable vertically (mouse drag) to adjust its y-position, which represents relative enthalpy. Bars snap to 0.5-unit increments.

ARROW PATHS (reaction arrows):
- 3 vertical arrows connecting levels:
  * Arrow 1 (ΔH₁): from Level A down to Level B (left side, x=-3). Color #4ecdc4. Represents C(s)+½O₂ -> CO, ΔH₁ = -110.5 kJ/mol (reference).
  * Arrow 2 (ΔH₂): from Level B down to Level C (left side, x=-1). Color #ff6b6b. Represents CO+½O₂ -> CO₂, ΔH₂ = -283.0 kJ/mol (reference).
  * Arrow 3 (ΔH₃): from Level A down to Level C (right side, x=3). Color #ffe66d. Represents C(s)+O₂ -> CO₂, ΔH₃ = -393.5 kJ/mol (reference).
- Arrows are built from a thin cylinder shaft + cone arrowhead, pointing downward from source to target level.
- Each arrow dynamically resizes as bars are dragged. A label next to each arrow shows its ΔH value computed as: ΔH = (target_y - source_y) * scaleFactor. The scaleFactor is set so that when bars are at default positions, ΔH₃ = ΔH₁ + ΔH₂ = -393.5 kJ/mol. So scaleFactor = -393.5 / (yC - yA) = -393.5 / (-4 - 5) = 43.722... kJ per unit.

HESS'S LAW VERIFICATION:
- Continuously compute: residual = |ΔH₃ - (��H₁ + ΔH₂)|.
- Display a HUD panel (top-right, DOM overlay) showing:
  * ΔH₁ value (2 decimal places)
  * ΔH₂ value (2 decimal places)
  * ΔH₃ value (2 decimal places)
  * ΔH₁ + ΔH₂ (sum, 2 decimal places)
  * Residual (2 decimal places)
  * A status indicator: green circle + 'Hess Law VERIFIED' if residual < 0.01, else red circle + 'NOT BALANCED'.

DOM CONTROLS:
- A 'Reset Positions' button that returns all bars to default y-positions (5, 0, -4).
- A 'Lock Diagram' toggle button. When locked: bars cannot be dragged, button text changes to 'Unlock Diagram'.
- An 'Add Annotation' button: clicking it then clicking on the 3D canvas places a small text annotation sprite at that world position. Store up to 5 annotations.
- A dropdown select to choose 'Reaction Set': options 'Carbon Combustion' (default, values above) and 'Nitrogen Cycle' (ΔH₁=-90.0, ΔH₂=-91.0, ΔH₃=-181.0, labels: 'N₂+O₂','2NO+O₂','2NO₂'). Changing the dropdown resets bar positions and updates labels and reference values.
- An 'Undo' button that reverts the last bar drag operation (store history of up to 10 moves).

KEYBOARD INTERACTIONS:
- Press 'R' to reset positions (same as Reset button).
- Press 'L' to toggle lock.
- Press 'Z' (with Ctrl held) to undo last move.
- Arrow Up/Down: if a bar is selected (clicked), nudge it by 0.5 units up/down.

STATE MANAGEMENT — expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
{
  levelA_y: number,        // current y of Level A bar
  levelB_y: number,        // current y of Level B bar
  levelC_y: number,        // current y of Level C bar
  deltaH1: number,         // computed ΔH₁ in kJ/mol
  deltaH2: number,         // computed ΔH₂ in kJ/mol
  deltaH3: number,         // computed ΔH₃ in kJ/mol
  deltaH_sum: number,      // ΔH₁ + ΔH₂
  residual: number,        // |ΔH₃ - (ΔH₁+ΔH₂)|
  hessVerified: boolean,   // residual < 0.01
  isLocked: boolean,       // lock state
  selectedBar: string|null,// 'A','B','C' or null
  reactionSet: string,     // 'carbon' or 'nitrogen'
  annotationCount: number, // number of placed annotations (0-5)
  undoStackSize: number,   // number of undo-able moves
  scaleFactor: number,     // kJ per world unit
  arrowLengths: {a1: number, a2: number, a3: number}, // pixel/world lengths of arrows
  barPositionsHistory: Array, // array of past states for undo
  initialized: boolean
}

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. Ensure all numerical values are never NaN or Infinity.
physics_constraints: Hess's Law conservation: ΔH₃ must always equal ΔH₁ + ΔH₂ when bars are at default positions. The residual must be computed as |ΔH₃ - (ΔH₁ + ΔH₂)|. Scale factor must remain constant within a reaction set. Bar y-positions must snap to 0.5-unit increments. All enthalpy values must be finite real numbers (no NaN/Infinity). Arrow lengths must equal |source_y - target_y| geometrically.
